scientific_integrity: Exact arithmetic and a proof are provided; numerical examples are not substituted for arguments over all prime powers or extensions.
scientific_limitations: The Weil-numerator shape and first coefficient are proved; the remaining coefficients are not computed. Genus, normalization branch structure and the degree-four point count are credited literature inputs. Odd characteristic only. Not independently audited.
title: Quartic Frobenius symmetry in an elementary abelian cover of the Hermitian curve
